'''Beamdrills''' were high powered, precision [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tools that produced a high-intensity [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] beam. The beam was fully capable of cutting through almost any material, including [[Stone/Legends|stone]], rock, [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]], [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], and [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Beamdrills were used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and industrial operations such as mining and constructions sites.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Beamdrills used intense pulses of energy to mine minerals such as [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and other ores. Beam drills were upgradeable, providing the drill with yet more power and precision to increase mining efficiency.

Beamdrills were readily available for purchase throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The devices generally cost fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy.<ref name="SWS" />

[[Keleman Ciro]] used one of these tools to freeze the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] controls in the "off" position in [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s [[Imperial Government Complex|headquarters]] during the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]]. This allowed [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces to land and liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TSB">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>
